name: Barbarian audit: One With The Ancestors raises crit chance natively (#1308)
contract: #1308: One With The Ancestors rank 1 (560452, EffectBasePoints 1 DieSides 1 = 2) and rank 2 (560889, EffectBasePoints 3 DieSides 1 = 4) are both a single plain APPLY_AURA effect with SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_PCT (290). AuraEffect::HandleAuraModCritPct ignores MiscValue and calls Player::UpdateAllWeaponDependentCritAuras() plus UpdateAllSpellCritChances(), which raise both PLAYER_CRIT_PERCENTAGE (melee_crit_chance) and PLAYER_SPELL_CRIT_PERCENTAGE1..7 (spell_crit_chance) by the aura amount; needs no script. PLAYER_CRIT_PERCENTAGE is only ever recomputed from AuraEffect handlers (UpdateAllWeaponDependentCritAuras has no call site outside them), so a freshly spawned character reads 0 until the first crit-affecting aura is applied or removed. The scenario primes that recalculation with a throwaway learn+unlearn of rank 1 before taking its baseline, so mcrit0/scrit0 reflect the character's true resting crit chance rather than an uninitialized field.

steps.label: Priming cycle: rank 1 applies before baseline
Priming cycle: rank 1 is removed again
